debrief db-021
1) the actor i-n-s-p-e-c-t-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k and d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y and t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e f-a-i-l-u-r-e-s
2) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d a f-o-r-m-a-t for r-e-l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g the g-o-o-d-s but n-o-t e-d i-t i-o-n to s-h-o-w t-h-e a-c-t-u-a-l c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n
3) the actor p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d a t-a-b-l-e of s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r-s and c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n l-o-g s that w-o-u-l-d m-i-s-c-a-l-l the r-e-c-o-r-d-s
4) the actor o-u-t-l-i-n-e-d a r-o-u-t-e to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s for d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n before a-u-d-i-t-s could o-c-c-u-r
5) the actor l-e-f-t the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t and s-e-a-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s t-o-u-c-h-e-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the q-u-a-r-a-n-t-i-n-e
